data.description:
## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase C Step 1 (Pre-Batch Checks) to add a recipe engine pre-flight validation step before Phase E sub-agent dispatch.

## Why
Instruction-file update: sprint orchestrator needs explicit guidance to validate recipe engine availability before any tasks execute, allowing early detection of missing/outdated engines.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Phase C Step 1 gains a 'Recipe Engine Pre-flight' block after the existing pre-check script calls
- SKILL.md pre-flight instruction: call bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/sprint/check-recipe-engines.sh --task-list=<current-batch-task-list>; if output contains MISSING_ENGINE or OUTDATED_ENGINE lines: surface warning to user listing missing engines with installation instructions from registry; store MISSING_ENGINES_LIST in session context for S5 fallback consumption; pre-flight does NOT block sprint (warn + continue)
- When NO_RECIPE_TASKS: log 'No recipe tasks in batch — skipping engine pre-flight' and continue (no user-visible output)
- When ENGINES_OK: log 'Engine pre-flight passed' (no user-visible output)
- Missing-engines list is single source of truth: S5 (LLM fallback) reads MISSING_ENGINES_LIST populated by this step
- Existing tests remain still-valid (SKILL.md is instruction-only)

## File Impact
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — instruction-file change; tests still-valid

## Dependencies
- 0632-8287 (check-recipe-engines.sh must exist before SKILL.md references it)
data.title: UPDATE: Add recipe engine pre-flight step to sprint Phase C
